title: Meiosis II: Chromatid Separation and Meiotic Regulation
method: Whitespace-delimited visible theory paragraphs before Part B excluding figures, tables, references, questions and UI; article total includes headings, figure captions, tables, questions, references, but excludes SVG and zoom buttons.
comparator: 2.C.10 checkpoint 8610 theory words / 18 sections; 2.D.07 has 16 substantive theory sections and focuses on second meiotic division.
scientific_checks: Mapped to official merged CSIR-DBT NET Unit 2.D p.3 and archived MP SET 2024 p.2 (both visually inspected); textbook and shugoshin primary/review evidence verified. First review covered phase sequence, centromere counting, suppression of licensing, co-orientation versus bi-orientation, local Rec8 protection, APC/C, anaphase, cytokinesis, assortment, crossover, nondisjunction, marker limits and exceptions. Second review added incorrect attachment figure and explicit crossover calculation, clarified marker patterns; recomputed quantitative answers.
limitations: Two self-review passes in examiner role, not independent human review. Static source inspection only; browser/device rendering, interaction and independent visual accessibility checks not performed. Current MPPSC-hosted SET syllabus not retrieved; archived 2024 used. Unpublished immediate neighbors remain unlinked; Pages verification pending.
